items.title: Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD) Q3 Earnings Surpass Estimates
items.summary: Robinhood Markets reported Q3 2026 earnings of $0.60 per share, beating consensus estimates of $0.56, but revenues of $1.42 billion missed expectations by 1.17%. Despite underperforming the S&P 500 by 17.9% year-to-date, the stock holds a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating based on favorable estimate revisions. Raymond James Financial is expected to report results on October 28 with projected earnings of $3.28 per share.

items.title: SEC Approves HOOD-Linked KPI Contracts: A New Growth Avenue Unlocked?
items.summary: The SEC approved Cboe Global Markets' proposal to list binary options tied to company-specific KPIs, with Robinhood Markets expected to become the first retail brokerage offering these contracts covering over 100 metrics across 23 companies. While this presents a new revenue opportunity aligned with Robinhood's active-trading strategy, near-term monetization is limited by pending clearing approvals and fee waivers through 2026. Regulatory uncertainty around event-driven products and the need for sustained customer adoption also present challenges.

items.title: Robinhood Markets Reports Earnings on Oct. 27. Is It a Better Buy Than Morningstar?
items.summary: The article compares Robinhood Markets and Morningstar as investment options for 2026. Robinhood demonstrates explosive growth with 51.6% revenue increase and 42.1% net margins, but trades at a premium valuation (P/E 48.94x) and faces significant regulatory risks. Morningstar offers stability with slower 7.5% growth, lower valuation (P/E 19.38x), and dividend income, but risks falling behind in AI adoption. The choice depends on investor risk tolerance and time horizon.

items.title: Bull of the Day: Robinhood Markets, Inc. (HOOD)
items.summary: Robinhood Markets (HOOD) has emerged as a legitimate competitor to Fidelity and Charles Schwab, operating 13 business lines generating $100M+ in annualized revenue each. The company recently launched AI-powered agentic trading tools and announced 24/7 weekend trading capabilities. Despite a 30% pullback from October 2025 peaks, HOOD posted strong Q2 earnings with 32% YoY revenue growth and 48% earnings growth, earning a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) rating with 25% upside potential from current levels.

items.title: Why Robinhood Markets Stock Popped Today
items.summary: Robinhood Markets stock surged 13.70% on Friday following optimism about cryptocurrency industry regulation. The Trump administration is pushing Congress to pass the Clarity Act, which would establish clearer crypto regulations and enable financial institutions to integrate digital assets more easily. CEO Vlad Tenev highlighted opportunities in tokenized stocks, which Robinhood already offers in 120+ countries but cannot yet provide in the U.S.
